from: everyone who has ever waited for Sam in a driveway
isms: Let me circle back on that.

title.kicker: The official record · a birthday in three chapters
title.title: SAM AT 40
title.subtitle: THE UNAUTHORIZED BIOGRAPHY
title.lead:
One legend. Forty years. Zero on-time arrivals.
Today: the birthday.

wrongText: "Let me circle back on that." Wrong. The room says try again.

arrival.text: A quiet street, a ten-speed with one working brake, and a kid who was told to be home when the streetlights came on. Sam heard "when the streetlights come on" as the opening bid in a negotiation. Every neighbor on the block has, at some point, been asked for five more minutes.

choice.question: It's 1994. The streetlights just came on. Where is Sam?

options.label: Pedaling home at top speed
options.reaction: Nice try. That bike did not have a top speed. It had a rattle and a dream.

options.label: Three streets over, mid-negotiation
options.reaction: "Five more minutes." It has been thirty years. We are all still waiting on those five minutes.

options.label: Already home, setting the table
options.reaction: Nobody in this room believes that, including Sam.

trivia.question: What did young Sam want to be when they grew up?
trivia.reaction: A professional snack reviewer. The dream is technically still alive, and frankly the portfolio is strong.

mini.title: The Lost & Found Box
mini.intro: Everything Sam lost before the age of twelve. Turn over two at a time. The clock starts on your first flip.
mini.win: All eight pairs in {secs} seconds. That is faster than Sam has ever found anything.

arrival.text: A dorm room the size of a parking space, a hot plate that was absolutely not allowed, and the first recorded use of the phrase "I'm basically a chef." The dish was ramen with a slice of American cheese on it. The fire alarm gave it two stars.

choice.question: It's finals week. What is Sam's study strategy?

options.label: Color-coded flash cards, started in October
options.reaction: The flash cards exist. They were purchased in October. They are still in the shrink wrap.

options.label: "I work better under pressure"
options.reaction: A thing Sam has said before every deadline since 2003. The pressure has never once agreed.

options.label: Cooking an elaborate meal instead
options.reaction: "I'm basically a chef." The exam was at 9. The risotto was ready at 9:15. It was, annoyingly, very good.

trivia.question: How many times did Sam change majors?
trivia.reaction: Four. Each one was "definitely the one." The fifth was graduation, and everyone agreed not to ask questions.

mini.title: Sam Makes Dinner
mini.intro: Five steps. One right order. A wrong press sets off the smoke alarm and resets the whole thing.
items: Use every pan in the building
mini.label: KITCHEN HEAT
lines: The announcement has been made. Brace.
Every pan. Including one nobody has seen before.
BEEP BEEP BEEP. Right on schedule.
Dinner is served. It is nearly tomorrow.
BZZT. That is not how Sam cooks. Start from the top.
mini.win: A flawless Sam dinner. Delicious, late, and the dishes are still soaking to this day.

arrival.text: A real job, a real badge, and a calendar that looks like a game of Tetris played by someone who is losing. Sam learned the four most powerful words in business, "let me circle back," and has been circling ever since. Somehow, every single person Sam has worked with would work with them again. That part is not a joke.

choice.question: The meeting could have been an email. What does Sam do?

options.label: Says so, out loud, in the meeting
options.reaction: Brave. Correct. The room went quiet. Three people sent Sam a thank-you note afterward.

options.label: "Let me circle back on that"
options.reaction: The circle has never once closed. Geometrically, it is a spiral.

options.label: Arrives five minutes late with snacks for everyone
options.reaction: Late, as always. Forgiven, as always. Those were good snacks.

trivia.question: How many unread emails does Sam have right now?
options: Sam will circle back on that
trivia.reaction: 14,212, and one of them is from you. Forty years in, the inbox is a mess and the friendships are spotless.

mini.title: Sam vs. The Inbox
mini.win: The Inbox is down. It will be back by Monday, but tonight belongs to Sam.

messages.msg: We left the porch light on. You can come home whenever. Five more minutes is fine.
We still talk about the risotto. We also still talk about the smoke alarm. Happy birthday, chef.

finale.heading: The last page
lines: The cul-de-sac. The dorm. The calendar that never had room and somehow always made room.
Every chapter, the same person: the one who shows up late and stays the longest, who cooks too much so there is always enough, who remembers what you said six months ago and asks how it went.
Forty years of five more minutes. Everyone in this room would give you five more, every time.
finale.final: Happy 40th, Sam. The best chapters are the ones still coming.
finale.toast: To Sam. Take all the time you need.

closing.title: Happy 40th, Sam.
closing.sub: Late to everything. Right on time for all of us. Love, everyone.
